title: Meals You Can’t Miss

chapters.description: Sweet grilled pork over rice and veggies
Creamy coconut fish curry steamed in a banana leaf
Stir-fried beef in savoury sauce served with rice, salad, and egg

editorial: Cambodian cuisine is quite distinct from its Southeast Asian neighbours and relies heavily on fermentation, which makes for strong (often pungent) flavours. The popular prahok ktis and fish amok are both fermented fish dishes.
If fermented foods aren’t to your fancy, there’s always grilled meats. But unlike the heavily marinated satays in Thailand and Malaysia, the Cambodian grilled meats are more austere.
